description:
Hi team,

For the upcoming campaign we’ll be using the Admixer zone ID **123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000**. We’ve set a custom floor price of **$0.5 CPM** to ensure we meet our minimum revenue goals. The targeting parameters are straightforward: we’re focusing on users who are **30 years old** and have interests in **sports** and **music**.

Please update the ad server configuration accordingly and let me know if any further adjustments are needed.
